name: NUPLAZID
indications_original:
NUPLAZID® is indicated for the treatment of hallucinations and delusions associated with Parkinson's disease psychosis [see 
                        Clinical Studies (14)].
contraindications_original: Recommended dose is 34 mg taken orally once daily, without titration. ( 2.1 ) Can be taken with or without food. ( 2.2 ) Capsules may be swallowed whole or opened and entire contents sprinkled over a tablespoon of certain types of soft food. ( 2.2 )
adverseReactions_original: NUPLAZID is contraindicated in patients with a history of a hypersensitivity reaction to pimavanserin or any of its components.  Rash, urticaria, and reactions consistent with angioedema (e.g., tongue swelling, circumoral edema, throat tightness, and dyspnea) have been reported [see Adverse Reactions (6.2)].
